{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Intensity Volatility", "construction": "standard deviation of R&D expense divided by sales over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with volatile R&D investments may have more uncertain future cash flows, leading to a risk premium. This volatility can be a proxy for the uncertainty of a firm's growth prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Capital Expenditure Acceleration", "construction": "change in capital expenditures divided by total assets from year t-2 to t-1, minus the same change from year t-3 to t-2", "rationale": "An acceleration in capital expenditures may indicate a firm's increased commitment to growth opportunities, but also increases the risk of overinvestment. This acceleration can capture the uncertainty associated with changes in a firm's investment strategy.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Growth Dispersion", "construction": "standard deviation of the change in inventory divided by total assets over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with volatile inventory growth may face challenges in managing their working capital, potentially leading to lower profitability. This dispersion can be a proxy for the operational risk of a firm.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Expense Persistence", "construction": "autoregressive coefficient from a regression of advertising expense on its lagged values over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with persistent advertising expenses may have a strong brand or market position, but also face the risk of overinvesting in advertising. This persistence can capture the effectiveness of a firm's marketing strategy.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Accounts Payable Turnover", "construction": "cost of goods sold divided by average accounts payable over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with high accounts payable turnover may have strong bargaining power with their suppliers, potentially leading to lower costs. This turnover can be a proxy for a firm's operational efficiency.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Tangible Asset Obsolescence", "construction": "accumulated depreciation divided by gross tangible assets", "rationale": "Firms with high tangible asset obsolescence may face challenges in maintaining their productive capacity, potentially leading to lower profitability. This obsolescence can be a proxy for the risk of technological disruption.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Consistency", "construction": "standard deviation of the change in the number of employees over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with consistent employee growth may have a strong corporate culture, but also face the risk of overexpansion. This consistency can capture the effectiveness of a firm's human capital management.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Trade Receivable Turnover Volatility", "construction": "standard deviation of the change in trade receivables divided by sales over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with volatile trade receivable turnover may face challenges in managing their working capital, potentially leading to lower profitability. This volatility can be a proxy for the operational risk of a firm.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Fund Asset Allocation", "construction": "percentage of pension fund assets allocated to equities", "rationale": "Firms with a high allocation to equities in their pension fund may have a higher risk tolerance, potentially leading to higher expected returns. This allocation can capture the risk preference of a firm's management.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Operating Lease Commitment", "construction": "total operating lease commitments divided by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with high operating lease commitments may face challenges in managing their capital structure, potentially leading to lower profitability. This commitment can be a proxy for the flexibility of a firm's investment strategy.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
